Subject: CSOAI crosswalk — ISO 20022 vs measured AI accountability

Hi SWIFT Research,

We have measured 17 SWIFT banks' ISO 20022 GPI messages against AI accountability obligations in the EU AI Act, CLARITY Act, and GENIUS Act. Every figure is signed and reproducible.

What we are NOT claiming:
  - that any SWIFT bank is non-compliant
  - that SWIFT endorses this measurement

Best,
Nicholas Templeman
